interface.SELECT: LE u64 mode=0,count<=64, followed by exactly count decision bytes (Allow=0,Prompt=1,Forbidden=2). Output requires 8+count and returns LE u64 selected_count plus increasing u8 batch positions; workspace unchanged.
interface.REDUCE: LE u64 mode=1,M original_count,N selected_count; exactly N records of LE u64 original_index, decision, host_length plus raw bytes. N<=M, increasing indices<M, decisions 0/2 and exact end required.
interface.REDUCE_output: Capacity>=16+8*N; LE u64 allowed_count,denied_count, then winning original indices, Allow followed by Forbidden, increasing within each group.
interface.REDUCE_workspace: Capacity>=N; writes exactly N flags (0 superseded,1 Allow,2 Forbidden). Success preserves unused output/workspace bytes.
interface.error_contract: Minimum output eight first; SELECT exact header/capacity then all tags; REDUCE complete frame then both capacities. All failures write neither output nor workspace; source is always unchanged. Raw host bytes need not be UTF-8.

behavior.complete_algorithm: Policy::compiled_network_domains: exact raw-host last non-Prompt winner and ordered Allow/Forbidden vectors.
behavior.hia_owns: SELECT excludes Prompt; REDUCE compares host bytes, chooses last winners and emits original rule indices in per-decision order.
behavior.rust_retains: Decision encoding, checked framing/capacity, structural output validation and owned final String clones. No Rust host equality, normalization, sorting or policy deduplication.
behavior.ignored_fields: Prompt hosts and every justification/protocol stay outside transport; raw from_parts hosts remain byte-exact.
behavior.error_scope: Malformed status/count/index/order/decision outputs panic with no Rust or empty-list fallback. Structurally valid but semantically wrong callee output is not proven correct by these guards; the real HIA/original-owner differential supplies semantic evidence.

interface.ADMIT: Exact LE u64 mode=0,decision (Allow=0,Prompt=1,Forbidden=2). Output eight bytes: one iff Allow, otherwise zero; workspace unchanged.
interface.PLAN: LE u64 mode=1,N, then N prefix frames. Each has token_count>=1, then token kind (Single=0,Alts=1), alternative_count and repeated byte_length/raw bytes. First token must be Single; Single has one alternative, Alts may have zero. Exact end required.
interface.PLAN_output: Three LE u64 words: rendered serialized byte count R, workspace 24*N+8+R, and output capacity 8+8*N. Workspace unchanged.
interface.RUN: Mode=2 with the same complete selected prefix frame. Workspace contains N+1 rendered offsets, two N-index arrays and R rendered bytes. Stable bottom-up merge sort compares token bytes lexicographically, then vector length; dedup emits the earliest equal rendered-vector index.
interface.RUN_output: Capacity>=8+8*N: unique count U then U selected-frame indices; writes exactly 8+8*U. Workspace requires 24*N+8+R.
interface.error_contract: Minimum output eight first; complete exact validation and checked layout before matching capacities; RUN output capacity before workspace. Errors preserve output/workspace; source always unchanged, unused successful capacity unchanged. Raw ABI bytes need not be UTF-8.
interface.empty_input: N=0 still performs PLAN/RUN: R=0, workspace eight and output eight bytes. Public owner requires no heap allocation.

behavior.complete_algorithm: Policy::get_allowed_prefixes: Allow admission, token rendering, ordered Vec<String> sorting and rendered-vector deduplication.
behavior.hia_owns: ADMIT decides Allow; PLAN sizes the rendered representation; RUN renders Single/Alts tokens, stably mergesorts vector indices and chooses unique rendered vectors.
behavior.rust_retains: Original rule iteration, as_any callbacks/downcasts, decision encoding, checked transport and structural output/UTF-8 validation, then owned result Strings. No Rust token rendering, sorting or deduplication.
behavior.effect_order: Each admitted prefix is encoded before the next callback. Non-PrefixRule, Prompt and Forbidden patterns are not inspected; callback/panic prefixes, shared-Arc inputs and independent owned outputs are preserved.
behavior.rendering: Single bytes are unchanged; Alts render exactly [ plus alternatives joined by | plus ]. Empty alternatives and delimiter-containing strings can collide; equality and ordering are on complete rendered vectors.
behavior.error_scope: Invalid native status or structural output panics with no Rust algorithm or empty-list fallback. Structurally valid wrong semantic results require the actual HIA/original-owner differential.

interface.source: LE u64 version=1 and event tag, 160-byte continuation state, exact event payload. Nine event tags BEGIN through HEURISTIC_READY.
interface.state: Magic, phase, flags, command/rule/path counters and indices, resource bits, checked sequence and zero reserved words; no global state.
interface.path_records: Rust Path::components discriminant and raw Normal OsStr encoded bytes; HIA owns component/length/byte equality. Linux native profile only, no raw-path parser or UTF-8 normalization.
interface.output: Exactly 200 bytes: 160-byte next state, append disposition, cleanup mask, action, operand and zero reserved word.
interface.validation: Validate full source/state/event/component frame before checking output>=200, then before any output write. Reserved words, phase/action facts, booleans, indices, sequence overflow and exact frame end are checked. Errors do not write. Each accepted event increments sequence once; BEGIN starts at1.
interface.workspace: Untouched on every call; source, output and workspace are live disjoint ranges for the synchronous call.
interface.transport: 512-byte stack frame with checked Vec spill; no native error becomes an unmatched result.

behavior.hia_owns: Exact/host/fallback routing; ordered rule ordinals, all-path admission and component equality, first equal-path stop, match retention/annotation, cleanup scheduling and fallback invocation decision.
behavior.rust_retains: Real containers/lookups, arbitrary Rule::matches and heuristic callbacks, owned results, original OS path services, Path::components encoding and check_multiple iterator/AsRef/Drop effects.
behavior.ordering: Any exact Some suppresses host/fallback, but selected bucket callbacks stay exhaustive and ordered. Missing and present-empty buckets remain distinct. Fallback clones the original command before callback.
behavior.metadata: Host PrefixRuleMatch gets the resolved program; HeuristicsRuleMatch metadata is retained. Returned owned objects remain independent.
behavior.failure: Invalid statuses/state/structural replies panic without Rust fallback. Already performed callback effects cannot be rolled back; semantically wrong but structurally valid replies require the real HIA/original differential.

interface.source: Complete borrowed raw UTF-8 bytes, without a length prefix or input copy.
interface.control: Exactly 32 read-only workspace bytes: LE u64 version=1, mode, expected_length, reserved=0.
interface.plan: mode=0 requires expected_length=0; success writes 16 bytes containing LE u64 semantic_tag and result_byte_length.
